geologyDiscoveries.title: Regolith Baseline Completed
geologyDiscoveries.finding: South Pole regolith: SiO₂ 45%, Al₂O₃ 22%, FeO 8%. Confirms anorthositic highlands composition.

geologyDiscoveries.title: Hydrogen Signal Detected
geologyDiscoveries.finding: Neutron spectrometer detects elevated hydrogen in adjacent PSR — possible subsurface ice.

geologyDiscoveries.title: Water Ice Confirmed
geologyDiscoveries.finding: Ice core: 5.6% water ice by mass in permanently shadowed regolith. ISRU potential HIGH.

geologyDiscoveries.title: Radar Ice Signature
geologyDiscoveries.finding: Circular polarization anomaly in Shackleton interior consistent with ice layers (1–3 m depth).

geologyDiscoveries.title: Volatiles Survey Complete
geologyDiscoveries.finding: H₂O, CO₂, CH₃OH, SO₂ mapped across 2 km PSR transect. Full volatile inventory submitted.

geologyDiscoveries.title: Full Geological Survey Uplinked
geologyDiscoveries.finding: 10 km radius survey complete. Rim in sunlight 86% of time. Data sent to Houston.
